description: Parses BIND9 named log lines (default, general, database, security, config, resolver, xfer-in, xfer-out, notify, client, unmatched, queries, network, update, dispatch, dnssec, lame-servers) into ECS fields plus a bind.* namespace.

set.description: Fallback only. BIND 9.11's 'print-time yes' logs local time with no UTC offset, so the shipper MUST set event.timezone (see elastic-agent-custom-logs.yml) to the server's real IANA timezone, or every @timestamp here will be wrong by the UTC offset.

script.description: Maps the BIND logging category onto ECS event.category/event.type
